project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: npm with Next.js build (Turbopack), prisma generate in postinstall
test_framework: vitest with mocked prisma/LLM. Tests in src/lib/__tests__/*.test.ts. Uses vi.mock for prisma and guardedLLMCall.
build_command: npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx vitest run to pass all tests. 2. Run npm run lint to pass ESLint. 3. Run npm run build to ensure Next.js builds successfully.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is generated by prisma generate (runs in postinstall). Not checked in.
setup_instructions: npm install (triggers prisma generate via postinstall). No DB needed for tests (prisma is mocked).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No running PostgreSQL needed for unit tests (prisma is mocked). Build requires prisma generate to succeed.
contribution_requirements: Feature branches from main. PRs require lint + build passing. Tests use vitest with mocked dependencies.
key_patterns: API routes: src/app/api/<resource>/route.ts with GET/POST. Uses formatErrorResponse, generateRequestId, validationError from @/lib/api-error. DB: prisma singleton from @/lib/db. LLM: guardedLLMCall from @/lib/guarded-llm. Tests mock prisma via vi.mock('../db') and LLM via vi.mock('../guarded-llm'). Types exported from module-specific types.ts files.
directory_structure: src/app/api/ - API routes (Next.js App Router), src/lib/ - business logic modules, src/lib/__tests__/ - vitest test files, src/lib/generation/ - pipeline stages, src/lib/prompts/ - versioned prompt templates, src/lib/voice/ - voice corpus logic, prisma/schema.prisma - database schema
